description: Recoverable capital expenditure under a lease clause: amortize a capital cost over its useful life or the lease-specified period, straight-line (declining interest) or level payment, with interest on the unamortized balance or none; optionally cap each year's recovery at demonstrated cost savings (with or without carry-forward); and allocate each year to tenants by pro rata share. Every assumption is echoed with an optional lease clause citation. Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.capex_recovery@1 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

amortization_years.description: Years over which the cost is recovered: the useful life, or the amortization period the lease specifies.

clauses.description: Lease clause behind each assumption, free text, echoed in the result's assumptions so a reviewer can check each against the lease.

amortization_period.description: Free-text lease reference for this assumption, e.g. "Lease §6.2(b)" or "First Amendment ¶4". Echoed with the assumption.

cost.description: Free-text lease reference for this assumption, e.g. "Lease §6.2(b)" or "First Amendment ¶4". Echoed with the assumption.

cost_savings_cap.description: Free-text lease reference for this assumption, e.g. "Lease §6.2(b)" or "First Amendment ¶4". Echoed with the assumption.

interest.description: Free-text lease reference for this assumption, e.g. "Lease §6.2(b)" or "First Amendment ¶4". Echoed with the assumption.

method.description: Free-text lease reference for this assumption, e.g. "Lease §6.2(b)" or "First Amendment ¶4". Echoed with the assumption.

pro_rata_share.description: Free-text lease reference for this assumption, e.g. "Lease §6.2(b)" or "First Amendment ¶4". Echoed with the assumption.

cost.description: Capital cost of the improvement to recover, USD (building level).

cost_savings_cap.description: Cost-savings limit: recovery in each year may not exceed the operating-cost savings the improvement demonstrably produces. Omit if the lease has none.

annual_savings.description: Demonstrated operating-cost savings per year, USD, the same every year. Give this or savings_by_year.

carry_forward.description: True if amortization disallowed by the cap in one year may be recovered in a later year of the period (still within that year's savings); false (default) if it is lost.

savings_by_year.description: Demonstrated savings for each recovery year, USD, one per year of amortization_years. Give this or annual_savings.

first_year.description: Calendar or lease year of the first recovery year, e.g. 2026; labels the schedule rows. Omit to number years 1, 2, 3.

interest_rate_annual.description: Annual interest on the unamortized balance as a decimal, e.g. 0.08; 0 (default) for none. Charged on the balance at the start of each year.

method.description: straight_line: equal principal (cost ÷ years) plus interest on the declining unamortized balance, so recovery falls each year. level_payment: a level annual payment like a mortgage, cost × r ÷ (1 − (1 + r)^−years), split into interest and principal. Identical when interest_rate_annual is 0.

period_basis.description: Where amortization_years comes from: useful_life (e.g. under GAAP or tax guidance) or lease_specified (a period the lease states). Labels only.

tenants.description: Tenants to allocate the annual recoverable amount to by pro rata share. Shares may sum to less than 1 (the landlord bears the rest), not more. Omit for the building-level schedule only.

pro_rata_share.description: Tenant's pro rata share of the recoverable amount, 0 < share ≤ 1.

title: Capital expenditure recovery
